# diff-coverage

> Measure test coverage of the lines a change adds or modifies by joining a unified diff with Cobertura XML or coverage.py JSON, with safe XML, path matching and a threshold Python package `trysac-diff-coverage`, import name `diff_coverage`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
